messages:
maya: heads up — invoice-preview just flagged ~0.3% of tokens attributed to SKU 'free-tier' after today's routing canary at 10:17 UTC. some tenants show negative reserved_credit.
jonah: which canary? routing-priority v2 that went out this morning?
arjun: yep. changed header normalization so older clientlib route hints can be dropped at the proxy.
maya: logs show route_resolution_id null for affected events. sample payload:
```
{
  "client_id": "acct-9876",
  "route_hint": null,
  "route_resolution_id": null,
  "tokens": 142
}
```
lia: billing-preview spikes came from the hourly rollup job that applies per-route overrides/discounts. it relies on route_resolution_id.
billing-bot: alert: invoice-preview delta > 0.5% for 12 tenants. impact estimate: ~$1.2k forecast drift in previews.
jonah: quick mitigations: 1) pause canary 2) fallback mapping treating null as last-known for 72h 3) shadow-replay to recompute previews for affected tenants.
arjun: pausing rollout now.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for routing-priority v2 canary -> target groups: 5% -> 0%. status: 12 nodes draining.
maya: good. need a detection query for events that lost route_resolution_id during 10:17–10:40 window. draft:
```
select tenant_id, count(*) as c
from events
where timestamp >= '2026-03-22T10:17:00Z'
  and timestamp <= '2026-03-22T10:40:00Z'
  and route_resolution_id is null
group by tenant_id
order by c desc
limit 200
```
lia: run that, but only backfill tenants with c > 50 to avoid full recompute.
jonah: also add guard in preview job: if route_resolution_id null and tenant had mapping recently, use last-known mapping (TTL 7d).
arjun: we don't persist last mapping in ingest path today. route-cache (redis) holds ephemeral mapping. i'll push fallback write on resolution and short TTL.
maya: who owns backfill?
lia: i'll own preview backfill orchestration; coordinate with arjun for route-cache patch and billing for thresholds.
billing-bot: scheduled: preview-backfill-job queued for detected tenants. ETA start: 30m after tenant list posted.
jonah: we should emit a high-signal metric when route_resolution_id transitions from not-null to null for the same session_id within 5m — catches header-normalization regressions during deploys.
arjun: adding metric now: ingest.metrics.increment('route_resolution_lost') — will ship hotfix to proxy in 15m.
maya: action items: (1) arjun — hotfix metric + route-cache fallback write (2) lia — detection query + kick preview backfill (3) jonah — add alert route_resolution_lost > 5/min (4) billing — hold invoice finalization for impacted tenants 24h or until reconciled.
jonah: wrote the alert into the runbook -> /runbooks/route-resolution-regressions.md :thumbsup:
arjun: hotfix pushed to canary nodes, metric visible in staging.
lia: detection query run -> 18 tenants > 50 events. posting list to preview-backfill queue now.
billing-bot: preview-backfill-job started for 18 tenants. progress: 0/18.
maya: thanks. sync in 1h if backfill still running. add any suspects to thread. :eyes:
